inputs.text: A Wisconsin jury convicted Harry Wait of election fraud and identity theft for requesting ballots for Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. That isn’t a harmless stunt; it’s an attack on the basic right of citizens to cast their own votes. Election officials and public leaders should stop treating scrutiny as a threat to trust. Trust is earned by enforcing clear rules, protecting lawful voters, and refusing to let talk of access become an excuse to overlook abuse.
